Tool logo sources

ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney:
Lobe Icons, @lobehub/icons-static-svg 1.95.0
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
https://unpkg.com/@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.95.0/icons/

Higgsfield:
Official Higgsfield AI public repository
https://github.com/higgsfield-ai/skills/blob/main/assets/icon.svg

Skywork AI:
User-provided company logo screenshot at ../skywork-logo.png

GitHub, HubSpot, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Python:
SVG Logos by Gil Barbara, via Iconify (CC0)
https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos
https://unpkg.com/@iconify-json/logos/icons.json

PowerPoint, Excel, Word:
VSCode Icons by Roberto Huertas, via Iconify (MIT)
https://github.com/vscode-icons/vscode-icons
https://unpkg.com/@iconify-json/vscode-icons/icons.json

Brand names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
